articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Binance France emails announce closure of its users’ accounts on Dec. 31
articles.description: Any assets left on the exchange will be charged monthly fees starting on Nov. 29, company says.

articles.title: These Finland homes get free heat from bitcoin miners (as long as BTC stays above $70,000)
articles.description: A Finnish startup has 30 bitcoin mining systems working as central heating, and at today’s prices each one earns slightly more than the electricity it burns.

articles.title: Amsterdam protesters break into Microsoft data center construction site: Report
articles.description: Dutch police said they detained 150-200 people for trespassing during the protest.

articles.title: Binance’s  finance chief Kaiser Ng to leave company, report says
articles.description: Ng will be replaced by Justin Yek, who was formerly vice-president of finance at Airwallex.

articles.title: Binance users in some European countries told to pull crypto before fees kick in, with accounts closing by year end
articles.description: Affected accounts are reportedly set to close on Dec. 31. Users in Spain, France, and Poland say they've received similar notices.

articles.title: U.S. Treasury moves to cut off crypto exchange MEXC over $16 billion in alleged illicit flows
articles.description: Treasury billed the move as part of its campaign against Iran, but the order rests on MEXC's alleged role in Russian illicit finance.

articles.title: Apple Completes the Set: Every Magnificent Seven Stock Opts Out of OKX-ICE Venue
articles.description: Apple and Meta’s objections mean all seven of the biggest U.S. tech companies have now asked to keep their shares off the planned OKX-ICE venue.

articles.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card numbers, home addresses and linked crypto wallets
articles.description: One user said the exposed data tied his home address and card number to every crypto wallet linked to his account, raising the risk of targeted scams.

articles.title: AI Chip Stocks Bounce After Global Rout—But Is the Bubble Starting to Burst?
articles.description: A Friday rebound offered relief after a historic selloff. The question now is whether politics and mounting debt could turn an AI correction into something much worse.

articles.title: Ex-FBI counterintelligence agent stole almost $2.5M in crypto
articles.description: Yaroch paid off his debts and intended to use the proceeds to finance a new life in Portugal, where he planned to buy a vineyard.

articles.title: Sony Axing Game Discs Will Have Outsized Impact on Low-Income Gamers, Experts Say
articles.description: Experts say a disc-free PlayStation will price out low-income players, while in much of Africa, digital-only gaming means breaking Sony’s rules.

articles.title: Bitcoin holders have received eCash — What can you do with it?
articles.description: Bitcoin’s eCash fork gives eligible holders an equivalent balance of ECX, but questions remain over where they can trade the tokens and what they can do with them.

articles.title: US sanctions Canadian money-exchange firms over Iran ties
articles.description: US also offers as much as $20 million and possible relocation for information about Iran’s nuclear program.

articles.title: Suspicious prediction market activity seen before election poll release: NYT
articles.description: Bets were placed shortly before two recent New York Times/Siena political polls were released to the public, according to a report.

articles.title: Nvidia may face a more hostile post-election Washington: Report
articles.description: CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with President Donald Trump probably won’t save the company from a more adversarial Washington, Semafor says.

articles.title: Treasury Cuts Crypto Exchange MEXC Off From US Financial System
articles.description: FinCEN’s order, part of Operation Economic Outcast, bars U.S. institutions from any transfers to or from MEXC, which Treasury says facilitated $16 billion in illicit finance tied to Iran, North Korea and Russia.

articles.title: US Treasury cuts off MEXC over alleged $16B in illicit transactions
articles.description: The US Treasury bureau FinCEN on Friday ordered US financial institutions to stop processing transfers involving MEXC Global.

articles.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card details, personal data and crypto wallet information
articles.description: The crypto debit card provider said customer funds remained safe despite the exposure of sensitive financial and personal information.

articles.title: Binance hack is ‘cyber war,’ TRM Labs executive says
articles.description: TRM Labs executive Ari Redbord called for governments to take offensive action against North Korean hackers following the record $6.3 billion Binance theft.

articles.title: Greece Passes Crypto Tax Law With 10% Gains Levy, 15% on Staking and DeFi
articles.description: Greece has approved a crypto tax framework with a €500 ($557) annual gains threshold and new rules for staking and DeFi income, but lawmakers left important questions about token swaps unresolved.

articles.title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch

articles.title: US 401(k) proposal leaves door open to altcoins, but hurdles remain
articles.description: While the proposal doesn’t exclude altcoins and smaller cryptocurrencies, experts say they could face challenges getting into retirement plans.

articles.title: Why a Hyperliquid Treasury Firm Wants to Become a US Futures Broker
articles.description: Hyperliquid Strategies has applied to become a U.S. futures commission merchant, a move that could let Americans trade perpetual futures on permissioned Hyperliquid markets, pending regulatory approval.

articles.title: Paraguay Protests Over Bank Lockout Intensify as Impeachment Vote Nears
articles.description: Savers locked out of Ueno Bank burned their cards, booed a former presidential candidate out of the crowd, and watched Congress move to remove President Peña.

articles.title: Russia finalizes crypto trading rules ahead of Nov. 17 rollout
articles.description: The rules allow retail investors to trade BTC, ETH and USDT through regulated intermediaries, with Moscow Exchange planning to launch crypto trading in December.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $430 Million as Tech Rout Tests Wall Street Buyers

articles.title: Strive buys 15,124 Bitcoin in October, closes in on top treasury holders

articles.title: Bitcoin price dips under $75K as crypto markets miss tech-stock rebound

articles.title: US Sanctions 45 More Targets Tied to Alleged Crypto Scam Empire Prince Group

articles.title: Crypto Card Provider Gnosis Pay Says Hackers Accessed Customer Data

articles.title: Anthropic IPO Valuation Could Be Slashed in Half to $1T After AI Stock Rout: Report

articles.title: The crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story

articles.title: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty

articles.title: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act

articles.title: U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October, blowing past 65,000 estimate
